notes: **2026-09-01** — (branch `fix/F05-driver-at-door-money-settlement`, rebased onto master `e41a1e28`; no schema change — F01 shipped the columns and they were dead) — **F05 driver at-door money + run settlement SHIPPED (B49 Critical, B83, B148, B152, B167).** One cause behind four screens: the run payload never carried the billed line money, so the driver app re-derived `qty × unitPrice` and over-collected ~`unitsPerBox` on every boxed stop — then posted that inflated figure as `payment.amount`. **G7 = `RUN_LINE_ITEMS_SELECT`** in `routes.service.ts`: one const for all three run-read sites (three copies of the literal before), now carrying `subtotal`/`boxes`/`pieces`/`unitsPerBox` — **F10/F11/F12/F22 consume it; extend it, never re-inline.** `getRunPackingList`s narrower include shape is deliberately excluded. Mobile money now goes through pure `lib/run-money.ts` (⚠️ Prisma Decimals arrive as STRINGS — always `Number()`). ⚠️ **B148 gated everything else:** mobile always sent `deliveries[].productId`, `RunDeliveryDto` never declared it, and the global `forbidNonWhitelisted` pipe recurses into nested DTOs — so EVERY stop completion 400d; the DTO now accepts it and both `deliveryMutation.create` sites persist it (also reviving `reopenStop`s `productId`-gated stock restore). **B83:** `recordDeliveryPaymentInTx` books its residual as an `AdvancePayment` (single-customer guarded; `reference` = `RUN:<runId>:STOP:<stopId>`, a LOAD-BEARING token `getRunCashCollections` matches by prefix) instead of warn-and-drop — including the zero-payable-invoice path that used to discard the whole amount. **B152/B167:** settlement is server-owned via `POST /route-runs/:id/settlement` writing F01s `settlementNote`/`settlementVariance`, surfaced read-only on `routes/[id]` for EVERY status. ⚠️ **The register missed the real bypass:** RF-016 auto-complete inside `completeStop`/`completeWithPayment` flips the run COMPLETED in its own tx, so gating `updateRunStatus` alone never fires on the common path — all three paths carry the predicate. ⚠️ Fable final pass: CANCELLED runs could strand cash unsettleable forever (now settleable post-hoc); **cancel-path + `deleteRun` gating handed to F11**. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
